messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "do not start another 14-day course within 4 months"
set: ["do not start another 14-day course within 4 months", "start another 14-day course within 4 months only if your doctor tells you to", "allow at least 4 months to pass before starting new 14-day course of treatment", "do not share with another person", "do not start or stop without asking doctor", "do not start new medication without telling doctor", "do not start or stop without doctor's advice", "do not take another dose for at least 24 hours", "do not start potassium supplements or different diuretics yourself", "do not use within 14 days before MAO inhibitor use", "tell doctor if symptoms do not improve within 7 days", "do not start or stop during pregnancy without doctor's advice", "use all ampules within 3 months after opening foil pouch", "do not inject two doses within 3 days of each other", "do not recycle", "do not breastfeed"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
